page.overview:
What is Harmonthep?

Harmonthep was a planet orbiting the star Delta Pavonis. Inglsey noted Harmonthep as the sixth stop in the Zensunni Wanderers' migration. At some point in time, there was a slave rebellion on Harmonthep and the Fremen held a ceremony that mourned it, as well as the similar events on Poritrin, Bela Tegeuse and Rossak. The planet was eventually totally destroyed.
